# Samarbeid - Agent Instructions

## Architecture Overview

Samarbeid is a **Rails 8 SPA** with a **Vue 2 + Vuetify 2**, backed by **PostgreSQL**. Rails serves the shell (`home#show`), then Vue Router handles client-side navigation. The frontend talks to an internal JSON API (`app/controllers/api/`) via axios. A separate **Grape API** (`app/api/samarbeid/`) provides the external/public REST API.

Key architectural layers:
- **Controllers** (`app/controllers/api/`) — thin, delegate mutations to Interactors, use CanCanCan for authorization (`load_and_authorize_resource`)
- **Interactors** (`app/models/interactors/`) — encapsulate business write operations as class methods; always accept a `user` param and create `Events::*Event` audit records
- **Services** (`app/models/services/`) — domain logic (search, workflow engine, automations, embeddings, LLM connectors); some instantiated, some class-method-only
- **Models** — use AASM state machines (`Task`, `Workflow`), `pg_search` for full-text, extensive concerns, and a Definition→Instance pattern (`WorkflowDefinition` → `Workflow`, `TaskDefinition` → `Task`, `DossierDefinition` → `Dossier`)

## Developer Workflow

```bash
bin/setup              # Install deps, prepare DB, seed data
bin/dev                # Start Rails + Vite dev server (Procfile.dev)
bin/rails test         # Run all tests (Minitest, parallelized)
bin/fix-code-style     # StandardRB (Ruby) + ESLint (JS/Vue) auto-fix
```

## Testing Conventions

- **Minitest** (not RSpec). Tests live in `test/` mirroring `app/` structure.
- **Fixtures** (`test/fixtures/`), not factories. All fixtures loaded globally.
- Look up fixture records by attribute: `User.find_by!(email: "dsb@example.org")`.
- Integration tests use `login_as(@user)` (Warden helper) for authentication.
- External HTTP calls are recorded with **VCR** (`test/cassettes/`). Wrap calls in `VCR.use_cassette("name") { ... }`.
- System tests use Capybara + Selenium with `minitest-retry` and `capybara-lockstep`.
- Helper `create_workflow_for!(definition)` bootstraps a workflow from a definition in tests.

## Code Style

- **Ruby**: StandardRB defaults (no `.rubocop.yml`). Run `bundle exec standardrb --fix`.
- **JavaScript/Vue**: ESLint Standard style + `eslint-plugin-vue` (vue2-recommended). Run `yarn run eslint 'app/**/*.{js,vue}' --fix`.
- Vue SFCs use **script-first** order (`<script>`, then `<template>`), kebab-case filenames, PascalCase `name` property.

## Frontend Patterns

- **Entry point**: `app/javascript/entrypoints/vue.js` → mounts `AppWrapper` with Vuetify, VueI18n, VueRouter, ActionCable.
- **API client**: `app/javascript/api/request.js` (axios wrapper with CSRF, cancel tokens, structured error classes). Endpoints built via `app/javascript/api/endpoints.js` using a `resources()` helper injected globally as a Vue mixin.
- **Mixins**: `requestable.js` for API calls, `cacheable.js`, `markable.js`, etc. in `app/javascript/mixins/`.
- **I18n**: German-only. Backend: `config/locales/*.de.yml`. Frontend: `app/javascript/i18n/modules/*.de.js`.
- **Real-time**: ActionCable channels (`app/channels/`) broadcast via `MonitorChannel`, `NotificationChannel`, `UserChannel`. Frontend uses `actioncable-vue`.
- **Responsive/Mobile**: Uses Vuetify 2's `$vuetify.breakpoint` API (e.g. `smAndDown`, `xs`, `xsOnly`) and built-in visibility classes (`hidden-sm-and-down`, `hidden-xs-only`) for responsive layouts. The site header switches from a toolbar menu to a `v-navigation-drawer` on small screens.

## Backend Patterns

- **Authorization**: CanCanCan with group-based permissions (`app/models/ability.rb`). All API actions must call `authorize!` or use `load_and_authorize_resource`.
- **Background jobs**: GoodJob (ActiveJob). Base class retries with `polynomially_longer`, captures Sentry errors. Scheduled jobs in `config/initializers/good_job_schedule.rb`.
- **Grape API**: Mounted at `/api/v0/`. Authenticates via an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header or `api_token` param. Uses Grape entities for serialization (`app/api/samarbeid/entities/`). See [app/api/samarbeid/AGENTS.md](app/api/samarbeid/AGENTS.md) before touching it.
- **Events**: All mutations create `Events::*Event` records for audit trail (`Events::CreatedEvent`, `Events::UpdatedEvent`, etc.).
- **Optimistic locking**: Models use `lock_version`; Interactors handle `ActiveRecord::StaleObjectError`.
- **Database**: The application extensively uses Postgres-specific features (e.g. `pg_search` for full-text search, `jsonb` columns, advisory locks).

## Key Directories

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `app/controllers/api/` | Internal JSON API for Vue frontend (~30 controllers) |
| `app/api/samarbeid/` | External Grape REST API |
| `app/models/interactors/` | Business write operations (class methods) |
| `app/models/services/` | Domain services (search, engine, automations) |
| `app/models/concerns/` | Shared model behaviors (labels, search, locking) |
| `app/javascript/pages/` | Vue page components organized by domain |
| `app/javascript/components/` | Reusable Vue components |
| `config/initializers/` | App config (GoodJob, Devise, Grape, Sentry, etc.) |
| `db/migrate/` | Database Migrations |

## Routing

Routes in `config/routes.rb` follow this hierarchy:
1. Devise auth at `/users/sign-in`, `/users/lost-password`
2. Grape API mounted at root (`/api/v0/...`)
3. RailsAdmin at `/admin`, GoodJob at `/good_job` (super_admin)
4. Experimental features under `namespace :experiment`
5. Internal JSON API under `namespace :api` (frontend backend)
6. SPA catch-all: `*path` → `home#show`

# samarbeid

Samarbeid is a powerful but intuitive and easy to use **collaboration plattform for small to medium-sized organisations**. Samarbeid is three-in-one 🛠️: it is for flexible task and process management, it is for task-oriented team communication and it is for integrated data and knowledge management. Samarbeid empowers teams with little to zero IT skills 🧓👩🏼👨 to manage all their processes and data in one place. Samarbeid is designed as a learning system for learning organisations.     




## Try samarbeid
You can try samarbeid in [our trial system](https://try.samarbeid.org). Login credentials are lutz@samarbeid.org | samarbeid or marie@samarbeid.org | samarbeid. 

## Features
- **Manage** all your tasks ✅ in light-weight but structured and **flexible processes**.
- **Communicate with the team** 💬 directly in the context of your tasks and processes.
- Add flexibly fields for **structured data into all tasks**.
- Use **process templates** to re-use best practices in your teams.
- Retain full flexibility by changing and **enhance each process individually** when necessary.
- Get **360° views** on the core concepts of your organisation (like each contract, customer or supplier) with **dossiers**.   
- Simply 📎 **add PDFs and other documents** to your tasks and processes - to store and find them in their relevant context.
- All data added to samarbeid is indexed by the **full text search** 🔍.
- **Manage the visibility** of processes and data at the level of groups.
- **Export all data** from your tasks and process for analyses and re-use in spreadsheet software. 
- Integrate your samarbeid **due calendar** 📅📆 into your personal calendar apps. 

## Licence

The logo of samarbeid, all other components of the coprorate identity of samarbeid as well as all contents of the website (https://samarbeid.org as well as all subpages) are explicitly NOT part of the project licensed here. Any use of these contents and the logo of samarbeid - outside of the use of the software - requires the written consent of the owner. Requests for this by e-mail to: kontakt@samarbeid.org


## Getting started

- Requirements: 
  - Ruby (see `.ruby-version` for exact version)
  - Nodejs and yarn package manager (see `.tools-version` ([asdf](https://asdf-vm.com/)))
  - PostgreSQL
  - Docker & Docker Compose
- `bin/setup`

Open http://localhost:3000 and you should see your local samarbeid running. A initial admin user account is automatically generated (see output of above command for details).


## Get in touch
If you want to learn more about samarbeid and the team behind the project please check the [samarbeid website](https://samarbeid.org). 

**Subscribe our newsletter** (4 issues per year) 📧 to regularly read a well curated overview about the latest developments in samarbeid. You find the subscription form at the [samarbeid website](https://samarbeid.org).

For **bug reports** please [create an issue](https://gitlab.com/samarbeid-org/samarbeid/-/issues/new), security vulnerabilities should be reported directly via e-mail to kontakt@samarbeid.org.

For **feature requests** and questions regarding our roadmap please write us an e-mail 💌 to kontakt@samarbeid.org

**Follow us** on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/samarbeid_org), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/82678036/) or [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/samarbeid_org/) to stay up to data about the samarbeid project.

## Software stack
Samarbeid is a Ruby on Rails application with Vue.js frontend. Our stack is:
- Ruby (MRI)
- Vue.js
- MaterialDesign via vuetify
- PostgreSQL
- GoodJob


## Releases

Samarbeid follows a **continuous deployment** approach 🚀. New improvements, fixes, and features are automatically released as soon as they pass our automated test and review processes, so the `main` branch always represents the latest stable version of the platform.

We also maintain a [Releases page](https://gitlab.com/samarbeid-org/samarbeid/-/releases) that highlights selected points in time (typically every six months) and documents the features and changes included since the previous release. These releases are provided for documentation purposes only and are not intended as upgrade points.=== bin ===

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
require "fileutils"

APP_ROOT = File.expand_path("..", __dir__)

def system!(*args)
  system(*args, exception: true)
end

FileUtils.chdir APP_ROOT do
  # This script is a way to set up or update your development environment automatically.
  # This script is idempotent, so that you can run it at any time and get an expectable outcome.
  # Add necessary setup steps to this file.

  puts "== Installing dependencies =="
  system("bundle check") || system!("bundle install")

  # Install JavaScript dependencies
  system! "bin/yarn"

  puts "\n== Copying sample files =="
  unless File.exist?("config/database.yml")
    FileUtils.cp "config/database.yml.sample", "config/database.yml"
  end

  puts "\n== Preparing database =="
  system! "bin/rails db:prepare"
  system! "bin/rails db:reset" if ARGV.include?("--reset")

  puts "\n== Removing old logs and tempfiles =="
  system! "bin/rails log:clear tmp:clear"

  unless ARGV.include?("--skip-server")
    puts "\n== Starting development server =="
    STDOUT.flush # flush the output before exec(2) so that it displays
    exec "bin/dev"
  end
end
